item.title: Bridgeman delivers superb performance at Riviera, builds 6-shot lead over McIlroy
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Jacob Bridgeman felt great about his game and his swing, and it wasn't long before everyone at Riviera took notice Saturday at the Genesis Invitational. They had no choice.

item.title: Petar Musa scores twice as Dallas beats Toronto 3-2 in MLS season opener
item.description: FRISCO, Texas (AP) — Petar Musa scored two goals on Saturday night, Logan Farrington added a goal and an assist, and FC Dallas beat Toronto FC 3-2 in the Major League Soccer season opener for both teams.

item.description: VANCOUVER — It took little time for Aziel Jackson to become a target on Saturday night.

item.title: Pakistan says it struck militant hideouts along Afghan border after surge in deadly attacks
item.description: ISLAMABAD (AP) — Pakistan said early Sunday it carried out strikes along the border with Afghanistan , targeting hideouts of Pakistani militants it blames for recent attacks inside the country.

item.title: Stars descend on the BAFTA film awards, with 'One Battle' and 'Sinners' leading the race
item.description: LONDON (AP) — TO MOVE AT 0500GMT SUNDAY Politically charged thriller “One Battle After Another” and blues-steeped epic “Sinners” lead the race for Sunday’s British Academy Film Awards as the two movies jostle for awards-season supremacy.

item.title: From abdication to Diana, Harry and ex-Prince Andrew. A look at major British royal scandals
item.description: LONDON (AP) — Holding prestige but not power, Britain’s monarchy is finely tuned to public sentiment.

item.title: Pelligrino's three-point night helps San Diego whip Montreal 5-0 in MLS season opener
item.description: SAN DIEGO (AP) — Amahl Pellegrino had a goal and two assists to help San Diego FC beat CF Montreal 5-0 on Saturday night in the Major League Soccer regular-season opener for both teams.

item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs as a partial government shutdown continues.
